title: Continuity of a function, types of discontinuity, graphs …
topicTitle: Continuity of a function, types of discontinuity, graphs of discontinuous function
notes: **Fact.** Indeterminate forms 0/0, ∞/∞, 0·∞ → L'Hôpital: lim f/g = lim f'/g' (when applicable).
**Fact.** Standard limits: lim_{x→0} sin x / x = 1; lim_{x→0} (1 + x)^{1/x} = e; lim_{x→∞} (1 + a/x)^x = e^a.
**Fact.** Continuity: f continuous at c iff lim_{x→c}f(x) = f(c). Types of discontinuity: removable, jump, infinite.
